attributes.action: Ban Category F2 & F3 consumer fireworks to protect public health and nature
attributes.additional_details: Peak celebration periods cause acute air pollution shocks, driving fine particulates (PM2.5) across residential areas to hazardous bands (DAQI 8–10). Fireworks release toxic heavy metal dust, sulphur compounds, and climate pollutants like black carbon. Compounded by winter weather inversions, these emissions endanger human respiratory health, contaminate local ecosystems, and inflict severe animal distress. We must transition to licensed clean tech displays.
attributes.background: Ban the consumer sale (Category F2 & F3) of pyrotechnic fireworks year-round. Annual pyrotechnic events cause hazardous air pollution spikes (PM2.5 DAQI 8–10), release toxic heavy metals, harm public health, damage ecosystems, and inflict extreme trauma on pets.

rejection.details:
I believe what you are asking for is already covered by these three petitions which you may wish to sign:

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893

Ban all loud fireworks and only allow silent ones to be sold in the UK
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/786349

Include fireworks in clean air laws & restrict high-smoke sales
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/786708
